app.TWFnZW50bw.short_desc.source: E-commerce platform for building online stores and managing customers, products, and orders
app.TWFnZW50bw.short_desc.message: E-commerce platform for building online stores and managing customers, products, and orders

app.TWFnZW50bw.desc.source: Magento is a flexible e-commerce platform that provides businesses with a complete solution for building and managing online stores. This integration allows you to automate workflows when customer, product, order, invoice, or shipment events occur in your Magento store.
app.TWFnZW50bw.desc.message: Magento is a flexible e-commerce platform that provides businesses with a complete solution for building and managing online stores. This integration allows you to automate workflows when customer, product, order, invoice, or shipment events occur in your Magento store.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Magento** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJDdXN0b2.message: Retrieve a specific customer account by ID

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJDdXN0b2.message: Retrieves detailed information about a customer account using the customer ID. Returns all customer attributes including address information, account status, and custom attributes.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJDdXN0b2.source: Updates customer information for an existing account. This endpoint allows modification of personal information, addresses, custom attributes, and other account details. The customer ID must be included in the request.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJDdXN0b2.message: Updates customer information for an existing account. This endpoint allows modification of personal information, addresses, custom attributes, and other account details. The customer ID must be included in the request.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJDdXN0b2.message: Remove a customer account by ID

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJDdXN0b2.source: Permanently deletes a customer account from the system. This operation cannot be undone and will remove all customer data associated with the specified ID, including addresses and order history references.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJDdXN0b2.message: Permanently deletes a customer account from the system. This operation cannot be undone and will remove all customer data associated with the specified ID, including addresses and order history references.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJDdXN0b2.message: Retrieve a list of customer accounts

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJDdXN0b2.message: Returns a list of customer accounts that match specified search criteria. Results can be filtered, sorted, and paginated. Use search criteria parameters to narrow results by email, name, creation date, or other customer attributes.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y3VzdG9tZXJBY2NvdW.message: Creates a new customer account with the provided information. Required fields include email, password, and first/last name. app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.message: Add a new product to the catalog

Products can be simple, configurable, bundled, grouped, virtual, or downloadable. Media gallery entries, tier prices, and custom options can also be defined.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.message: Creates a new product in the catalog with specified attributes, pricing, and inventory information. app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.message: Retrieve a list of products from the catalog

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.source: Returns a collection of products that match the specified search criteria. Results can be filtered by attributes like name, SKU, price, and status. Supports pagination, sorting, and inclusion of custom attributes in the response.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.message: Returns a collection of products that match the specified search criteria. Results can be filtered by attributes like name, SKU, price, and status. Supports pagination, sorting, and inclusion of custom attributes in the response.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.source: Updates an existing product in the catalog. Can modify any product attribute including name, price, description, images, inventory, and category assignments. The product SKU or ID must be specified in the request.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.message: Updates an existing product in the catalog. Can modify any product attribute including name, price, description, images, inventory, and category assignments. The product SKU or ID must be specified in the request.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.source: Remove a product from the catalog
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.message: Remove a product from the catalog

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.source: Permanently removes a product from the catalog by ID or SKU. This operation cannot be undone and may affect existing orders and carts that reference the deleted product.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.message: Permanently removes a product from the catalog by ID or SKU. This operation cannot be undone and may affect existing orders and carts that reference the deleted product.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.source: Retrieve detailed information about a specific product
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.message: Retrieve detailed information about a specific product

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.source: Retrieves comprehensive information about a specific product by SKU or ID. app.TWFnZW50bw.action.Y2F0YWxvZ1Byb2R1Y3.message: Retrieves comprehensive information about a specific product by SKU or ID. The response includes all product attributes, images, pricing information, inventory status, and category assignments. Additional parameters can control which data is included.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.cXVvdGVDYXJ0UmVwb3.source: Retrieve a list of active shopping carts
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.cXVvdGVDYXJ0UmVwb3.message: Retrieve a list of active shopping carts

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.cXVvdGVDYXJ0UmVwb3.source: Returns a collection of active shopping carts that match the specified search criteria. Results can be filtered by customer ID, creation date, and cart status. Each cart includes items, applied coupons, and shipping/billing information if available.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.cXVvdGVDYXJ0UmVwb3.message: Returns a collection of active shopping carts that match the specified search criteria. app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.source: Retrieve detailed information about a specific order
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.message: Retrieve detailed information about a specific order

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.source: Retrieves comprehensive information about a specific order by ID. Includes order items, billing and shipping addresses, payment information, applied discounts, and order status history. Useful for order processing and customer service inquiries.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.message: Retrieves comprehensive information about a specific order by ID. Includes order items, billing and shipping addresses, payment information, applied discounts, and order status history. Useful for order processing and customer service inquiries.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.source: Retrieve a list of orders based on search criteria
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.message: Retrieve a list of orders based on search criteria

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.source: Returns a collection of orders that match the specified search criteria. Results can be filtered by customer, status, date range, and total amount. Supports pagination and sorting to efficiently browse large order volumes.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.message: Returns a collection of orders that match the specified search criteria. Results can be filtered by customer, status, date range, and total amount. Supports pagination and sorting to efficiently browse large order volumes.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.source: Persists order information to the system
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.message: Persists order information to the system

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlclJlcG.message: Performs persist operations for a specified order. Saves the order data to the database, including customer information, line items, payment details, shipping information, and other relevant order metadata.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlck1hbm.source: Append a comment to an existing order
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlck1hbm.message: Append a comment to an existing order

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlck1hbm.message: Adds a comment to the order history. Comments can be internal (visible only to administrators) or customer-visible. Each comment is timestamped and attributed to the author. Useful for documenting order processing steps and customer communications.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlck1hbm.source: Retrieve the comment history for an order
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlck1hbm.message: Retrieve the comment history for an order

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlck1hbm.source: Returns the complete comment history for a specific order. Results include comment text, timestamp, author information, and visibility status (customer-visible or admin-only). Comments are returned in chronological order.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNPcmRlck1hbm.message: Returns the complete comment history for a specific order. Results include comment text, timestamp, author information, and visibility status (customer-visible or admin-only). Comments are returned in chronological order.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNJbnZvaWNlUm.message: Returns a list of invoices based on specified search criteria. Results can be filtered by order ID, customer, date, and amount. Each invoice includes line items, payment information, and related order details. Supports pagination and sorting.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNJbnZvaWNlUm.source: Creates a new invoice for an order
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNJbnZvaWNlUm.message: Creates a new invoice for an order

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNJbnZvaWNlUm.source: Creates a new invoice record for an existing order, documenting the financial transaction and payment request. Allows for specifying line items to be invoiced, payment details, and comments that will appear on the customer's invoice.
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNJbnZvaWNlUm.message: Creates a new invoice record for an existing order, documenting the financial transaction and payment request. Allows for specifying line items to be invoiced, payment details, and comments that will appear on the customer's invoice.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNTaGlwbWVudF.message: Retrieve a collection of order shipments

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNTaGlwbWVudF.message: Returns a list of shipments based on specified search criteria. Results can be filtered by order ID, customer, creation date, and tracking information. Each shipment includes items shipped, quantities, tracking numbers, and carrier information.

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNTaGlwbWVudF.source: Creates a new shipment for an order
app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNTaGlwbWVudF.message: Creates a new shipment for an order

app.TWFnZW50bw.action.c2FsZXNTaGlwbWVudF.message: Creates a new shipment record for an existing order, allowing you to document and track the physical sending of order items to the customer.
